what_we_ask: clone the repository at the commit named in this directory
create a fresh virtualenv and run exactly: pip install uibc-core==0.5.0 asn1crypto cryptography
run `python tools/stranger.py` and paste its log, unedited
fill reply-template.json and return it with the log
what_this_proves: That the corpus reproduces on a machine we do not control, and that a verifier we did not build agrees with the verdicts. It does not make the corpus conformant, and it does not make the submitter independent unless they say so and the ledger can see it.
what_it_does_not_prove: conformance of anything to the specification's intent
that a second implementation exists (this is still the reference verifier)
that the checks are correct, only that they answer the same way twice
